additional_info.subject: RE: 0380827 - ID0380827-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / R8 170002531] Firmware update issue CRM:00641000675
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Szymon,
I hope this message finds you well.
We cannot conclusively determine the issue remotely without a proper circuit inspection, but there is a possibility of a short circuit in the downstream components, which include the ET200SP, router, HMI, switch, and HPC cable controller.
It's crucial to verify these components to ensure they are functioning correctly.
A thorough inspection will help identify any issues related to power supply, loose connections, or hardware faults.
According to the schematic, the FC14 circuit breaker or fuse is connected to provide overload or overcurrent protection for the downstream circuit. The ET200SP, router, HMI, switch, and HPC cable controller are all part of the FC14 circuit.
Please review and check all the components marked in the schematic attached below.

additional_info.subject: RE: 0380827 - ID0380827-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / R8 170002531] Firmware update issue CRM:00641000675
additional_info.body:
Hi,
I am adding an update of the situation.
On Wednesday 25.09, Vishal and I did checks on the entire line of wires that come out of FC14 (it was throwing an error). The measurements showed no problem on the power lines, the fuse itself is also working fine.
We decided to perform a fault check using the new HMI.
On 30.10. I arrived on site with the new display for testing (Gen.2). We did not observe any problems after connecting the 24V, after connecting all the wires: DP, C, 24V, RFID no problems were observed. We discussed the case with Shrey and the decision was taken to replace the HMI.
I attach the video.
While the SCB showed a problem with CP1, let's leave it until the station update.
Today we are ordering a screen.
With best regards,
